title: 电话与消息

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：I'm calling about [the reason]. / Just following up on [previous topic].
sentenceFrames.usage: 打电话/语音的开场——一句话说清目的。
sentenceFrames.example: Hey, I'm calling about the meeting next Tuesday. Just wanted to confirm the time.
substitutions: I'm calling about **the reservation I made online. I want to...
I'm calling about **the job application I sent last week. I was wondering if...
Just following up on **that email I sent. Did you get a chance to...
你自己的场景：I'm calling about _____. / Just following up on _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：Could you [request]? / Would it be possible to [polite request]?
sentenceFrames.usage: 电话中提请求。Could you 是日常用法，Would it be possible to 更正式。
sentenceFrames.example: Could you send me the details by email? / Would it be possible to reschedule our call to Thursday?
substitutions: Could you **repeat that? The line is a bit choppy.
Could you **put me through to the HR department?
Would it be possible to **get a refund?

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：Let me just [confirm / check / make sure I got this right]. So [summary].
sentenceFrames.usage: 确认你听懂了对方的意思。这是好电话沟通者的核心习惯。
sentenceFrames.example: Let me just make sure I got this right. So you need the report by Friday noon, and it should include the Q2 numbers. Is that correct?
substitutions: 对方说了一个地址和见面时间 → Let me just confirm. So _____.
对方解释了一个问题的处理方式 → Let me make sure I got this right. So _____.
你自己的想法：你在电话中要怎么确认一个重要信息？
